q1_issues.issue: (Time westermayer then) hangs the event-only Time role on a person; a copular/measure clause with a time modifier must anchor the time on a reified state (the "Alice was ill on Friday" route), not on the subject entity.

"former manager" is given the full cessation bundle (past-state atom plus a same-symbol strength-0 denial), which the instruction set scopes to the stative "no longer / not anymore / used to" wordings.
Goal is used for "tipped her to another position", but the PP names what the tip-off was about rather than a destination, which routes to the preposition-named oblique instead.
The scale age and unit year are both supplied although "was 26 then" states neither a dimension word nor a unit.

q2_gaps: privative/temporal adjectives on a role noun ("former manager", "ex-", "would-be") — no encoding is defined, and cessation is explicitly limited to "no longer / not anymore / used to"
a bare numeral age predication ("was 26") — Measures requires a stated adjective or dimension noun and a stated unit
"another N" — distinctness from a salient antecedent has no carrier (one-anaphora covers "one", not the exclusion "another" adds)
notes: The single witness for "a friend and former manager", the factive know (sealed Theme plus the same atoms asserted at top level), the adjective-PP-complement reification of "unhappy in her job" with its flat dual-emit, and Possession for "her job" are all correct; the witness is named sk_person_1 rather than the sk_<class>_<n> the convention specifies.
